title: Sacabambaspis to cod
description: Replaces cod with sacabambaspis based on that one model
body:
Changes all cod to sacabambaspis based on that one funy model image thing. Includes entity model, items, item names including any mentions of cod in the language files. This also means you have to search sacabambaspis not cod to find items.
Uses custom entity models (CEM) so you need a mod like entity model features or optifine for it to work. Probably works on most versions of the game only tested on 1.21.6.
